source: Dutch as spoken in Flanders (standard Belgian Dutch), level Start (Pre-A1) for adult English speakers. Every word is in the derived Dutch word list (content/src/nl/WORDLIST.md, npm run content:wordlist -- nl) at level Start: NT2Lex (Tack et al. 2018, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) levels by first observation, attestations in Naar Nederland (werkboek, word list) and topic additions for Belgian standard forms. Units follow the Richtgraad 1 domains of Flemish adult education (content/src/nl/SOURCES.md). Grammar: zijn and hebben, personal pronouns, the present of regular verbs, yes/no and w-questions, numbers 0-20, niet and geen. English meanings written by the content author; plan: content/src/nl/PLAN.md.
